purpose: One-shot out-of-sample corroboration check of the cycle-3 cap-$30 finding (docs/proposals/2026-09-26-c1-leveraged-backtest-plan.md) on the 2016-01-04..2021-08-05 SIP window, which the canonical trend rules have never been evaluated on before. Rules, configs and the $30 cap were fixed before this window was examined (docs/proposals/2026-09-29-unseen-window-test.md, reviewed 2026-09-29 by antigravity + claude-agent -- binding). Runs exactly once: the CLI refuses if the results file already exists (run lock).

priorWork.cycle3Window: 2021-08-06..2026-09-25 (already examined many times; cannot confirm anything further on its own)
priorWork.cycle3Finding: at C1's real $20 per-entry cap the canonical trend rules lose to buy-and-hold QQQ, but at a $30 cap both S1 and S2 beat QQQ at roughly matched drawdown on 2021-08-06..2026-09-25 (S1 17.8% CAGR / 34.8% max DD, S2 19.6% / 29.9%, vs QQQ 15.5% / 35.0%)
priorWork.descriptivePrereg: lev-backtest-prereg.v2.json (mode descriptive, Alpaca IEX feed, 2020-07-27 start; superseded no strategy conclusion, only established the cap-sizing bug fix)

data.source: Alpaca SIP daily bars, adjustment=all (split+dividend adjusted), via fleet paper keys, read from the local cache bus/fleet/data/lev-bars-sip/ (no network at backtest time)
data.cashLegDepth: BIL SIP depth confirmed 2016-01-04..2026-09-28, 2699 bars, 0 missing days (cycle-4 fetch); this is what makes the 2016-2021 window usable as the cash leg.

cashLeg: BIL (adjusted total return) while out of market
execution: signal on the underlying's close at t; fill at the traded ETF's open at t+1 (bars[i+1].open); no fill at the same bar as the signal

windows.description: the evaluation window is the first fill after the common 250-bar warm-up (about 2017-01) through 2021-08-05 inclusive -- the last day before the v2/cycle-3 evaluation span began. Every series is cut at windowEnd BEFORE any signal or return is computed, so nothing after 2021-08-05 can influence any number in the report; no return is attributed before the 250-bar warm-up completes.

y2018.note: calendar 2018 (the Feb-2018 volatility spike and the Q4-2018 drawdown), reported separately, not gating

crash2020.note: the 2020 crash and recovery, reported separately, not gating

S1_trend_band.rule: long when underlying close > SMA(n)*(1+band); flat when close < SMA(n)*(1-band); otherwise keep the prior state

S2_dual_fast_exit.rule: long when SMA(50) > SMA(slow) and close > SMA(slow); exit when underlying close < SMA(50) OR the underlying's close falls trailingDD below its high since entry; re-enter only when the entry condition is true again

S3_vol_target.rule: S1(n=200, band=2) gate; when long, weight = min(1, targetVol / (leverage * realizedVol20(underlying))); rest in cash leg
S3_vol_target.note: secondary; weak fit for a $50 account; reported, not part of hypothesis H

strategies.canonicalWhy: S1, S2 and S3 are UNCHANGED from the cycle-3 run and from prereg v2's canonical configs. No grid search, no tuning and no selection happens in holdout mode; the configs were fixed before this window was examined.

costs.expenseRatio: NOT added: adjusted prices already net the fund's expense ratio out of NAV (adding it would double-count)
costs.cash: BIL adjusted returns already include its yield

cashAccountRules: engine forbids a round trip that opens and closes on the same day (no selling a position bought with unsettled funds). A same-open swap between traded ETF and BIL is allowed. Whether Alpaca applies further rules is UNVERIFIED.

primaryHypothesis.text: On QQQ->TQQQ at cap $30 and 5 bps, for BOTH S1 and S2: after-cost CAGR > buy-and-hold QQQ CAGR AND max drawdown <= buy-and-hold QQQ max drawdown + 2 percentage points.
criteria: max drawdown <= buy-and-hold QQQ max drawdown + 2 percentage points
primaryHypothesis.window: full evaluation window (first fill after warm-up through 2021-08-05); the sub-spans are reported, not gating

verdictRules.HOLDS: both S1 and S2 meet both conditions at 5 bps AND at 15 bps
verdictRules.PARTLY HOLDS: it holds at 5 bps only, or for only one of S1/S2

reportedNotGating: the other pairs (QQQ->QLD, QQQ->QQQ, SPY->UPRO, SPY->SSO, SPY->SPY)

multipleTesting.deflatedSharpe: Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2014): DSR = Phi( (SR_hat - SR0) * sqrt(T-1) / sqrt(1 - g3*SR_hat + ((g4-1)/4)*SR_hat^2) ), SR0 = sqrt(V[SR]) * ((1-gamma)*Phi^-1(1-1/N) + gamma*Phi^-1(1-1/(N*e))), gamma = 0.5772
multipleTesting.N: N = 36 (2 caps x 3 configs x 6 pairs)

oneShot: The run happens once. A rerun is allowed only to fix a code bug, with a regression test shown to fail on the pre-fix code, and both reports kept. Enforced by a run lock: --holdout refuses if bus/fleet/data/lev-backtest-holdout-results.md already exists.
verdictVocabulary: This is never reported as a pass. Even "H HOLDS" means only "consistent with the cycle-3 finding on one more ~4.6-year window"; it is not evidence of a durable edge and does not by itself justify raising C1's cap.
disclosures: The rules and the $30 cap were chosen before this window was examined; the cap came from a different window.
The window has no 2008-style bear market; drawdowns are not worst-case for 3x ETFs.
Round-trip counts are small (S1 ~1-2 trades/yr); confidence intervals would be meaningless and are not computed.
Raising C1's cap changes bus/city/survive-budget-envelope.js (protected): the owner's decision, not this test's.
2020-07-27..2021-08-05 prices (IEX) were used as indicator warm-up by the v2 runs and in the cycle-4 SIP-vs-IEX price comparison -- used, never scored.
The cycle-4 SIP fetch was a raw price pull with a gap/sanity check only, no signal/return/equity computed on 2016-2021.

Hindsight: everyone involved knows how 2018 and 2020 played out, and 200-day trend rules are known to have sidestepped parts of both; the configs are canonical, which limits but does not remove this bias.
unverified: Alpaca free SIP-tier history depth beyond the cycle-4 spot check
fractionability of traded ETFs (confirmed live 2026-09-29 for the descriptive prereg's symbol set, not re-verified here)
cash-account good-faith/settlement handling beyond the same-day rule

runLock.rule: --holdout refuses to run if this file already exists; delete/move it only to knowingly allow a documented rerun per the one-shot rule above.

secrets: error messages must redact APCA-API-KEY-ID and APCA-API-SECRET-KEY values; selftest asserts no key substring in any thrown error
